parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain how a uniform magnetic field and a uniform electric field may be used as a velocity selector for charged particles.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Particles having mass $m$ and charge $+1.6 \times 10^{-19}\text{ C}$ pass through a velocity selector. They then enter a region of uniform magnetic field of magnetic flux density $94\text{ mT}$ with speed $3.4 \times 10^{4}\text{ m s}^{-1}$, as shown in Fig. 8.1.

{{figure:figure_8_1}}

The direction of the uniform magnetic field is into the page and normal to the direction in which the particles are moving.

The particles are moving in a vacuum in a circular arc of diameter $15.0\text{ cm}$.

Show that the mass of one of the particles is $20\text{ u}$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: On Fig. 8.1, sketch the path in the uniform magnetic field of a particle of mass $22\text{ u}$ having the same charge and speed as the particle in (b).
